text:
ITEM 1 | Thinly sliced red onion rings, pale pinkish-white with purple-red edges, layered loosely in curved half-rings, glossy moist surface, some pieces separated and some stacked, about 1-2 mm thick, spanning roughly 9 cm across the lower-left and center of the bowl | 85
ITEM 2 | Halved cherry tomatoes, bright red with pale seed-pocket interiors and glossy skins, scattered among the onion, a few pieces showing juicy cut faces, about 2-3 cm each, sitting in the center-top of the bowl | 60
ITEM 3 | Green bell pepper strips, bright glossy green with pale ribbed edges, curved thin pieces about 4-5 cm long and 1 cm wide, lying at the upper-right rim of the bowl beside the tomatoes | 25
ITEM 4 | Thin carrot shreds or matchsticks, orange with slightly darker edges, dispersed in small clusters among the onion and tomato, each piece about 2-3 cm long and under 0.5 cm wide, scattered across the center | 5
ITEM 5 | Clear watery liquid, glossy and thin, pooled lightly at the bottom of the stainless steel bowl around the vegetables, not clearly visible as a separate mass, with small droplets clinging to the bowl wall | 15
